Internal helper: the filters of a call that name a variable

Source: R/checks.R
dot-jst_filters_naming.Rd

When a variable an analysis needs to vary has one value, and a filter's condition names that variable, the filter is the cause, and the stop says so in place of guessing (Session 346; Jeff, on jlm(Flourishing ~ SocialSupport + PriorTherapy, subset = PriorTherapy == 1): "the error message doesn't address the real problem"). The filters are this call's subset = and the frame's active jsubset() filter; jcomplete() keeps cases with values and cannot leave one value of a variable it names.

Usage

.jst_filters_naming(terms, sample_info, data_name)

Arguments

terms

Character vector; the variables or terms that have one value.

sample_info

The list .jst_build_sample_info() returns.

data_name

Character(1) or NULL; the data frame's name.

Value

A list: per and stored (logical: does that filter name one of the terms' variables), their condition texts, and vars, the variables the naming filters name.
